svg.title: JDBC Save and findPage Sequence
svg.desc: Sequence diagram rebuilt from exposed-jdbc README save/findPage examples, JdbcRepository.findPage source, and repository pagination tests.
svg.text: Concrete repositories insert records; findPage validates inputs, counts rows, then fetches a limited content slice.

g.text: count plus large offset content query
This is a sequence diagram: save inserts first, then findPage counts and selects the requested slice.
findPage validates page inputs and returns an empty ExposedPage for an out-of-range page.
